items.title: Haywood Hillyer Interview, 1958-05-13
items.q: you can pull your hair out over the screeches of Mr. Presley in that rocker school of, of, uh, so-called entertainment.

ctx.x: I couldn't say that with authority. I could say that they played jazz, but to say they were not Bonafide Jazz Bands would call for definitions which I'm not competent to give or I'm not even competent to identify. You know what I mean? I'm just not that conversant with the whole jazz movement. It was something which I'd say sort of passed me by without my being opposed to it, without my being any part of it. So jazz has actually meant absolutely nothing in my life, in my musical experience. It's meant nothing to…
Thank you. Well, getting back to the parties again, would you say that most of the musicians that played, maybe the poppers, they tend to play mostly jazz music?
